title: Pure Battleguard
summary: Battleguard cards with generic Level 5 EARTH Warriors, Rank 5s and staples; the page's Noble Knight starter (Isolde) is left out. Battleguard Echoes, the newest card, searches a Level 5 EARTH Warrior when activated. Each time a monster returns from the field to the hand, it searches Battleguard Rage or Howling, or flips a monster face-down. Battleguard Cadet searches Feast of the Wild LV5, which revives two Level 5 Warriors for a Rank 5. Cadet also tributes itself to summon Battleguard King. Hayate the Earth Star and Tenma the Sky Star summon each other from the hand and negate attacks or effects aimed at your Warriors. Pyrite Knight returns a Warrior to the hand to trigger Echoes. Battleguard Howling and Rage return monsters to the hand too.
